key.answer_key: No, not straightforwardly. Panel F1n shows residual H2O2 after each repeated H2O2 spike rising from 28 to 38 to 40 uM (a3) -- the unconsumed H2O2 accumulates across successive spikes rather than being fully consumed, so the plot itself does not simply confirm the claim; the text asserts consumption but the ruling has to come from this rising residual series.
